2. The broad and material fact relevant for disposal of this review petition is that, the plaintiff-petitioner filed Title Suit No. 708 of 1981 against the defendant-respondent for declaration of title partition and delivery of khas possession. Admittedly Syed Md. Ali Azam who was the owner of the suit land died leaving behind his wile 5 sons including Syed Wazed Ali Azam and 2 daughters. The defendant allegedly purchased the suit property from the legal heirs of late Syed Md. Ali Azam on 11.8.72. According to the plaintiff Syed Wazed Ali Azam was not present in the country and as such a forged sale deed by forging the signature of said Syed Wazed Ali Azam who had admittedly 2 annas and odd share in the suit property was created. The plaintiff on 11.9.80 purchased the share of Syed Wazed Ali Azam in the suit property by registered sale deed and hence filed this suit. 

 5. In dismissing the leave petition we held that Title Suit No. 589 of 1983 having been dismissed upto the Appellate Division by holding that the plaintiff did not acquire any title by the said purchase, the question of plaintiffs title in the suit was concluded and as such the same cannot be re-agitated in the present Title Suit No. 708 of 1981 for declaration of title partition and delivery of khas possession.
